notes.title: What’s Coming in Version 1.6.0
notes.content: [p]Since [b]July 18[/b], when Countless Army [b]celebrated its anniversary[/b], there haven’t been any new updates. But don’t worry — [b]the wait will be worth it![/b][/p][p]In the next version, I’ll be reworking the [b]rebellion system[/b], making rebellions function in a different way so they feel less frustrating. On top of that, they’ll be enhanced with [b]challenges[/b], as a rebelled province will now include specific objectives you’ll need to complete in order to reclaim it. This will make rebellions a much more engaging challenge.[/p][p]But that’s not all: some of these challenges will be [b]exclusive to Hard Mode[/b], which will now be renamed [b]Game+ Mode[/b]. Even now, this mode already includes several hurdles that require prior knowledge of the game, so it makes more sense to introduce it after the first playthrough instead of offering it right from the start.[/p][p]These are early ideas and, as always, they may change during development — or even include surprises not mentioned here (as has happened with every past version). As I progress, I’ll be sharing more updates little by little.[/p][p]I hope you enjoyed version 1.5.0 and its summer event, and that you’ll also be excited about what’s coming with version 1.6.0.[/p]

notes.title: Balance Tweaks, Visual Improvements, and Bug Fixes
notes.content: [p]This small update comes to polish the game's balance, improve defense information visibility, and fix several bugs that have been reported.[/p][p][/p][h2]Balance Adjustments[/h2][list][*][p]Everlasting has been rebalanced due to being too difficult.[/p][/*][*][p]Bauble has been adjusted because one of its routes was harder than intended.[/p][/*][*][p]South Canicula has also been rebalanced for the same reason.[/p][/*][*][p]The number of Watchers summoned per division has been reduced from 6 to 3.[/p][/*][*][p]The cooldown (CD) of Watchers has increased from 5 to 10 seconds.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Changes[/h2][list][*][p]All minimaps have been revised to remove the red areas that indicated defense positions.*[/p][/*][*][p]All map routes have been adjusted to better match the actual paths.[/p][/*][*][p]All conquerable buildings have been revised to ensure the improvements are fully visible within the camera view.[/p][/*][*][p]The Armory now gives 5 bonus resources, or 10 if you've already conquered the capital of the kingdom.[/p][/*][*][p]Defense signs have been visually redesigned and now adapt better to the screen:[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44090812/39a2a6219e39cf0b584838ee35571f01e1d33941.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]If a defense is placed high on the screen, its sign will now appear below it to remain visible.[/p][/*][*][p]Several signs have had their position corrected to ensure proper centering.[/p][/*][*][p]In gamepad mode, the display of signs has been reworked to avoid overcrowding the screen.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]*While removing the red zones might seem like a negative change, the new defense system with strengths and weaknesses means knowing the defense's location doesn't help much—you still don’t know its type or which troops will be most effective until you engage.[/p][p][/p][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]The Dragon could get stuck at the end of the path when trying to use a spell.[/p][/*][*][p]The Necromancer could also get stuck in the same situation.[/p][/*][*][p]Occasionally, selecting the resource option when upgrading the Armory caused a bug where no resources were received at the end of the invasion.[/p][/*][*][p]In the load game / new game screen, the conquered provinces on saved files were overlapping visually.[/p][/*][*][p]The DF skin for the Entremundos had an incorrect walking animation, making it look like it was constantly dying.[/p][/*][*][p]The army setup template would reset each time a troop was selected on the upgrade or skin screen.[/p][/*][*][p]The descriptive text for building choices after conquest was not centered when the camera was zoomed in.[/p][/*][*][p]In gamepad mode, it was impossible to replay maps from the expansion.[/p][/*][*][p]A visual bug caused mission 1 of the mini expansion to appear selected when it wasn’t (and vice versa) in gamepad mode.[/p][/*][*][p]Some windmills were incorrectly interpreting which defense unit had entered them.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Version 1.5.0 is here!
notes.content:
[p][b]Version 1.5.0 is here—just in time to celebrate Countless Army’s anniversary![/b][/p][p]And of course… the Liche is throwing a [b]beach party[/b], and you’re all invited![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44090812/6364c9e7e0c44685cca232dc0ea8f5727b44a289.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]To mark the occasion, party posters have appeared all across Ocelis. There are [b]6 in total[/b], scattered throughout the different realms.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44090812/db36815db7a30387a02e3e80ea076eb46ef96e12.png"][/img][/p][p]If your troops walk past them… you’ll [b]unlock exclusive beach party-themed skins![/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44090812/7d78c86a2589e93dc30c2c01eb353d6c07c89e8b.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p][b]Soldier[/b] – [b]Surfer[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Emaciated[/b] – [b]Duck[/b] [b]Splash[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Standard[/b] [b]bearer[/b] – [b]Super[/b] [b]Fan[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Reaper[/b] – [b]Lifeguard[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Mass[/b] – [b]Jelly[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Necromancer[/b] – [b]Lich[/b] [b]Fan[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]The event will run from [b]July 18th to August 1st[/b].
Collect them all before the party ends!


But beware... This update isn't all fun and games: the Lich has gotten serious, sharpened his vision, and made the balance of power shine...[/p][p][/p][h2]The Lich’s Visión[/h2][p][/p][previewyoutube="WkWgXfOfnBc;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]As you can see, almost all of the [b]visual noise[/b] from the ground has been [b]removed[/b], and new details have been added as well. The realm where these changes shine the most is Canicula, where even [b]new decorative elements[/b]—like cacti—have been introduced.[/p][p][/p][h2]Shield Spell[/h2][p]First, the shield spell is getting an adjustment: [b]instead of being a permanent shield[/b],[b] it will now last for 5 seconds[/b]. To compensate, the cooldown (CD) will be [b]reduced from 40 to 20 seconds[/b]. [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44090812/f21d6a90add179ad446cbc5567ef5a52df57e5c4.gif"][/img] This will make the spell much more strategic, rather than something you just use every time the cooldown resets.   [/p][h2]Skill Tree Selection[/h2][p]Several people (unfortunately I don’t have their names noted) suggested it would be better if selected [b]upgrades in the skill tree were marked with a circle to make them clearer.[/b]  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44090812/64ae4eb12a459d051ddfa9708adeab0eba956b9d.png"][/img][/p][h2]Changes to Troop Cards[/h2][p]Until now, troop cards had a fairly basic design, and even caused some visual issues with certain units — especially the Emaciated, which would almost disappear into the background.[/p][p]They’ve now been [b]redesigned to be clearer, more visually appealing, and to avoid these problems[/b].[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44090812/26f1704187316d6597632bd5eb144f3749d84ece.gif"][/img][/p][p]As you can see, this update applies to [b]both troop cards and profession cards[/b].[/p][p][/p][h2]The Lich’s Balance[/h2][p][b]All troops and defensive units have been rebalanced, [/b]with adjustments to all their stats. Additionally, an important change has been made to the “CD” (cooldown) stat, which now no longer affects the time between divisions, but the time between units within the same division.[/p][p]For those who want more details, a full breakdown of all balance changes can be found below in the news. For those who prefer a quick overview: [b]the game is much more balanced and demands greater strategy.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]I hope you enjoy all the new features that version 1.5.0 brings. notes.title: New troops Cards and Canicula Fully Rebalanced
notes.content: [p]We’re getting closer to version 1.5.0! This week, I’m showing you a small but important [b]change to the troop cards[/b]… and the complete rebalance of the [b]hottest realm in Ocelis, Canicula[/b].[/p][h2]Changes to Troop Cards[/h2][p]Until now, troop cards had a fairly basic design, and even caused some visual issues with certain units — especially the Emaciated, which would almost disappear into the background.[/p][p]They’ve now been [b]redesigned to be clearer, more visually appealing, and to avoid these problems[/b].[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44090812/26f1704187316d6597632bd5eb144f3749d84ece.gif"][/img][/p][p]As you can see, this update applies to [b]both troop cards and profession cards[/b].[/p][p][/p][h2]Changes in Canicula[/h2][p][b]Canicula has also been fully reworked[/b]. Just like Estesa, Nevura, and the other realms, all maps have been reviewed and adjusted to the new balance system.[/p][p]And this time, no map has been spared — they’ve all received updates, whether in paths, defenses, or both.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44090812/39886ced72bb527fb0b7b79f9c6f290c30fe0351.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]The new routes are designed to encourage a wider range of strategies, pushing players to carefully consider which troops to deploy based on their strengths and weaknesses.[/p][p]With this, six realms have now been fully updated to the new system. Only one remains before the [b]release of version 1.5.0[/b], which —as you already know— is set for [b]July 18[/b], coinciding with the anniversary of Countless Army.[/p][p][/p][p]See you very soon with the final updates before the big day![/p]

notes.title: 1.5.0 arrives on the 18th! Nevura rebalanced and more updates
notes.content: [p]Today, the [b]release date for version 1.5.0 is announced[/b]… but first, let’s take a look at the progress since the last update.[/p][h2]Kingdom of Nevura[/h2][p]The kingdom of Nevura is [b]now fully rebalanced[/b]. Only one map, Rivers of Lina, has been spared from path adjustments.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44090812/a6eab5d384ffaf0a00a61a1fc355926dfd0ba486.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]As you can see, most of the changes have focused on defenses. The path changes have been minimal, and when present, they’ve mainly served to better [b]align the defenses[/b] and ensure they interact properly with the game’s [b]new balance system.[/b][/p][p][/p][h2]Version 1.5.0 Release Date[/h2][p]That’s right! Version 1.5.0 now has a target release date: the 18th of this month, which also marks the anniversary of Countless Army.[/p][p]This update will include everything mentioned in the first announcement about it… [b]and a lot more![/b] Bug fixes, gameplay improvements, and several new additions I’m currently finalizing to [b]further polish the overall balance of the game.[/b][/p][p]I hope you enjoy these updates. See you very soon in the next devlog![/p]

notes.title: Estesa Rebalanced: New Paths and Defenses
notes.content: [p][b]Game balancing continues to move forward[/b], and this time we’re focusing on the [b]kingdom of Estesa[/b], which has been [b]completely reworked[/b].[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44090812/617423b1ce5cebc0a6c2e988b36dddd919a6f558.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Most of Estesa’s maps required an [b]almost total overhaul[/b], as they didn’t fit well with the new balance system. Only one map has kept its original paths, though its defenses have been adjusted.[/p][p]As you can see, many paths have been changed, and along with them, [b]most defenses have also been rebalanced.[/b][/p][p]The goal of these changes is to better align the maps with the current system of strengths and weaknesses between troop types. In Estesa, many routes lacked tactical relevance—there were paths where no troop types had clear advantages or disadvantages. With this update, each route now features its own pros and cons, encouraging more strategic use of troops and their types.[/p][p]The next kingdom to be adjusted will be the [b]kingdom of Nevura.[/b][/p][p][/p]

See you next week with more news![/p]

notes.title: What’s Coming in Version 1.5.0
notes.content:
[b]Last week we said goodbye to the Toledo Matsuri event[/b], but it's not all bad news, I'm here to talk about [b]version 1.5.0.[/b]

Toledo Matsuri was a great experience for me, as it was my first time participating in a live, in-person event. Thanks to that, and to all the feedback I received, I noticed that some aspects of the game could use a [b]bit of refinement[/b]. Specifically, the [b]tileset graphics and the overall game balance[/b]. Let’s dive a bit deeper into these two areas.

[b][h2]The Lich’s Vision[/h2]
[h3]Tileset Graphics[/h3][/b]

For those unfamiliar with the term, a tileset is a collection of graphics used for the environment—floors, walls… and in this case, I’m referring to [b]the floors in Countless Army.[/b]

At launch, Countless Army looked slightly different. I made a small visual improvement to reduce visual noise, but I feel that wasn’t quite enough. Here’s a small preview of what’s coming:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44090812/f2cbd37b7ac31fe1955cb45241424ca0f6fb4d73.gif[/img]

As you can see, the floors and paths have been simplified to make them less visually overwhelming. It’s still [b]in development[/b], so I’d really appreciate any feedback or suggestions you may have.

This update will apply to every map in the game.

[b][h2]The Lich’s Balance[/h2]
[h3]Game Balance[/h3][/b]

Do you think there's a troop that feels too weak or too strong? Would you like to see any unit tweaked or reworked in some way? Drop a comment. [b]I’ll consider your suggestion for update![/b]

Watching people play live made me realize that troop stats need a proper review. That’s why, in the next update,[b] I plan to go over all unit attributes… and also defenses.[/b]

This process will be quite interesting, as I’m even considering adjusting the "CD" stat so that, instead of marking distance between divisions, it will define the spacing between units within a division.

If you enjoy the more technical side of things, I’d love to publish a devblog-style post with deeper insights into this topic, so stay tuned.

These are the main changes coming in [b]version 1.5.0, but they won’t be the only ones![/b]

[b]Thank you all so much for playing Countless Army![/b]

notes.title: Interface Improvements and Bug Fixes
notes.content:
During the Toledo Matsuri in-person event, I was able to spot some bugs and notice that certain elements needed adjustments to improve the player experience.

This quick and small update is intended to fix the issues I observed during the event and also to introduce an improvement focused on the upgrade menus when capturing a building.

The improvement makes it so that, when the camera is zoomed out, the upgrade menu automatically scales up as well, allowing for better visibility. Additionally, I’ve added some visual feedback when hovering over the buttons, which was previously missing. Here’s a quick look at that change (este cambio fue propuesto hace tiempo por "McStuffins T. Fox"):
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44090812/14122e6daa8b01e73e3675aa070773d7b0579cee.gif[/img]


Here’s a list of the changes made in this update:[list]
[*] The Necromancer had a bug that prevented it from summoning troops.
[*] Anti-air defenses, the "Needles", did not speed up along with the game speed.
[*] The "exit match" button removed the dark overlay of the pause screen.
[*] Upgrade menus when capturing a building now also scale up when the camera is zoomed out, making them easier to see.
[*] Upgrade buttons are now highlighted when you hover over them.
[*] Upgrade descriptions now appear regardless of which of the three options you are selecting.
[*] Continuously pressing the "Cancel Invasion" button would cause the game to freeze.
[*] The "Shinigami" skin from the Toledo Matsuri event had a bug and couldn’t be obtained.
[*] Spell cooldown numbers were not visible in Realm 5 (Nevura); they’ve been changed to appear in black.
[*] Flag numbers were also not visible in Realm 5 (Nevura); they’ve been changed to appear in black.
[*] Some bushes had incorrect depth values, causing them to appear over other objects in the scene.
[*] The defense stats panel would appear even when the final menu or camera mode was active.
[/list]

[b]Thank you all so much for playing Countless Army![/b]

Now [b]Lucas has small voice lines[/b] to add more personality to the game. You will hear him during skin selection, skill tree upgrades, and in story events such as capital conquests, the beginning, and the end…

notes.title: Improvements to Save Systems
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Over the past few days, I’ve been fully focused on resolving the issues related to the save system.

The two main challenges were [b]corrupted saves[/b] and [b]Steam Cloud[/b] integration. I’m happy to announce with a big smile that both issues are now resolved! (or at least they should be).

Additionally, I’ve made some adjustments to the auto-save system. These changes not only improve how it works but also optimize the game’s performance by limiting how often it saves. The game should now run a bit smoother!

[h2]Steam Cloud Saves[/h2]
Steam Cloud saving is still in the testing phase. Although I’ve spent several days testing it with positive results, I want to be completely transparent: while this feature is in Open Beta, I cannot guarantee that save files won’t be lost. To be safe, I recommend making backups of your saves before trying it out.

[h2]How to Test These Improvements?[/h2]
If you’d like to test these new features, you can join the Open Beta. [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/2413640/announcements/detail/4444583635753894017]Here’s a link with instructions on how to access it.[/url]

Thank you for your continued support and for playing Countless Army. See you in the next invasion!

notes.title: Things 1.2.0 will bring
notes.content:
The 1.1.0 was launched two weeks ago, this update brought a lot of new things. Such as a new cover image, new transition, new victory screen, more sounds… And in general a lot of things to excite the player experience.
Sadly with this update there were a bunch of errors that have been reported. The biggest have been fixed thanks to a hotfix  I tried to make the fastest I could, but some small ones could be there while I’m still trying to fix them.

But I think it is time to work on version 1.2.0. And here I’ll leave a tentative content in the update. I have to say that various things have been proposed by you, the players. I’ve been reading each comment that you post, because they help me to improve the Countless Army.


The 1.2.0 will bring:

[h2]New things:[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Controller support[/b]. To give more options to players, adding the possibility to play with a joystick seems essential.
[*] [b]Support for Steam Deck[/b]. My idea was to make Countless Army compatible with the console, and for the next update I want to do it.
[*] [b]A button to reset the skill tree[/b] (Proposed by “Lavan”). As Lavan mentioned, the profession is something that you feel more than read, because you don’t know how they will fit on your composition until you try it. To change the elections on the skill tree, a button to reset it is a good gamble.
[*] [b]See all the shortcuts on the option menu[/b](proposed by Lavan). Lavan mentions that there’s some shortcut that isn’t mentioned in any place and he is right. To afford this I added an option to said menu to see every keyboard shortcut or from the controller.
[*] [b]A button to keep the army configuration[/b] (Proposed by “McStuffins T. Fox”). As McStuffins T. Fox mentions, actually if you use an army configuration that works and you don’t want to change it, a button to use the same army from a previous invasion is a very good idea to speed up the troop selection.
[*] [b]A button to end the actual wave[/b] (Proposed by “McStuffins T. Fox”). On some occasions we find that the objective has been conquered way easier than we thought previously, and then we have to wait until the wave ends to start the next one. With this  button all the troops that are in the battlefield will die, and the ones that aren’t on it will disappear, giving place to the end of that wave.
[*] [b]A pause button[/b] (Proposed by “McStuffins T. Fox”). As he says, if you play at high speed sometimes you can’t think in which place you want your spells. For that a pause button will bring more strategy, pausing the game and launching the spells thinking better each movement.
[/list]


[h2]Changes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Reduce rebellions[/b]. They are an important part of the game, but it is true that they happen more often than I like. For this reason the same will be reduced.
[*] [b]The not upgradable stats will also be visible[/b] (*roposed by Lavan). Some units don't upgrade some stats and actually they can’t be seen. Lavan mentions that those should be visible even if you can’t upgrade them to compare it and then make better strategies. This will change making them visible.
[/list]


All this new stuff and changes are the ones planned and I’ll try to bring in the 1.2.0. There’s more proposals and ideas that I’m still thinking about, so it is possible new ones could be added on the way.

This update is planned for Halloween week, at the end of the next month. 

I’ll keep you updated about my work each week, as I did with the 1.1.0.

Thanks you all a lot for being here, enjoying Countless Army!

notes.title: Waves are coming!
notes.content:
Since a while I planned to improve the summoning troops system, the former wasn’t really what I wanted. The objective of Countless Army is to be an Reverse Tower Defense, and when I looked up the main characteristics… It didn’t have waves! For that reason I was working on including it. Next I’ll show the changes in such system:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44090812/dd649029b82b444bf17fcc30952a687397453d84.gif[/img]

For each wave, you can choose the troops that travel each path, appearing in the summoning order that you’ve chosen. The victory depends on how you manage your waves

Once selected, they will launch the assault, during which you can aid your troops with spells to achieve your objectives.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44090812/c52a06a23c403a8e1d12f3d1cb94bf8a88601ee5.gif[/img]

When the waves finish, because they reach the objective or they die, if you didn’t conquer the map, you’ll have to prepare the next wave, learning from the former.

This is one of the thing in which I’ve been working, soon I’ll bring new notices, stay tuned!
